paper.title: Ace-Skill: Bootstrapping Multimodal Agents with Prioritized and Clustered Evolution
paper.central_claim: 联合按熟练度分配rollout和语义分簇知识组织，缓解低效数据访问与知识干扰，改善多模态工具任务并使知识跨域/跨模型复用。

provenance.notes: 指定sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；未提供独立运行凭据，actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref留null，不探测。

sections_read: Figure1–6 captions and full textual case study; no appendix supplied/announced

evidence.quote: Breaking this loop requires treating compute allocation and knowledge organization as a coupled optimization problem.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者定位采样预算和知识干扰两个对象。

evidence.quote: provides an exploration floor that prevents starvation and preserves broad coverage.
evidence.support_explanation: 不确定性、困难偏置和探索底线共同决定采样，反馈是既往奖励。

evidence.quote:
the cluster structure can be specified
a priori
rather than adapted online.
evidence.support_explanation: 聚类结构离线固定，不能说在线进化聚类器。

evidence.quote: we further apply a compaction step that iteratively merges the most similar pair until the pool size falls within the budget.
evidence.support_explanation: 簇内经验合并与容量控制明确，但无反事实效用准入。

evidence.quote: the same MLLM serves as the reasoning agent, trajectory summarizer, experience & skill merger, and verifier, all operating in no-thinking mode.
evidence.support_explanation: 判断器同模型，校准和错误传播未独立审计。

evidence.quote: Training runs for 50 steps with batch size 8
evidence.support_explanation: 给400样本访问预算，未给端到端token/时间。

evidence.quote: achieves a mean Avg@4 of 31.40 and Pass@4 of 48.23, improving over the Vanilla Tools baseline by +8.22 and +6.91 points, respectively.
evidence.support_explanation: 四域聚合任务收益；非独立运行验证。

evidence.quote: on VisualToolBench into TIR-Bench, and those from MMSearch-Plus into AgentVista.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确源/目标跨benchmark复用，为留存跨域证据。

evidence.quote: The Prioritized Sampler alone lifts the baseline from 39.37 to 46.25 Avg@4. The Clustered Organizer alone reaches 45.75.
evidence.support_explanation: 双模块有拆解；相对39.37的6.88和6.38之和超过完整10.63，不能称super-additive。

evidence.quote: introduces a dual-stream framework that jointly accumulates experiences and skills through visually grounded summarization
evidence.support_explanation: 本文叙述XSkill最近邻已含经验/技能双流，本贡献在分簇和采样。

evidence.quote: We directly inject the knowledge bootstrapped by Qwen3.5-35B-A3B into the smaller Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-4B at inference time.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存知识跨模型使用；非权重更新。

evidence.quote: yields super-additive improvement on both scales.
evidence.support_explanation: 与35B所列数字的加法交互不符，双模块收益不等于正交互。

E.statistics.reason: 报告四次每题尝试及各域结果/小模型负例，但无跨进化种子、区间或显著性。
